name.zh: 弯龙（异弯龙启发成年形态）

scope: Original whole living Camptosaurus dispar-inspired adult using corrected cranial reconstruction and explicitly identified C.dispar postcrania. Not Theiophytalia, Uteodon or a resized existing dinosaur.

taxon.context: Late Jurassic Morrison Formation; no precise co-occurrence claim
anchors: Brill & Carpenter Fig3.2 E/F and Fig3.3 corrected composite skull
Gilmore1912 USNM4282/2210 postcranial mounts only; obsolete pose/head excluded
Carpenter & Wilson2008 Fig23 B–E C.dispar manus

scale.basis: All artist nominal proportion targets, not specimen measurements. NHM broad genus summary gives5m; allow coherent proportion refinement and report actual bounds.

pose: Calm bipedal balanced stance on two hind feet; trunk near horizontal with modest rise forward, tail carried clear of ground as counterbalance. Short forelimbs relaxed with inward-facing palms, not forced palms-down pronation. Avoid old kangaroo/tail-prop mount pose. No stand.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 4–6 muted olive/tan/umber palette colors; no exact pigment claim.
surface_profile.detail: Smooth coherent low-poly broad facets; restrained color variation without invented fossil patterns. Closed single-sided solids, no scales-by-thousands or detached spheres.

coordinates.origin: Actual active-scene referenced world vertices in Blender XYZ meters: lowest Z=0; select abs(Z)<=1e-7m; origin XY is midpoint of combined contact XY extrema. Uniform mesh-local translation keeps all object/root transforms identity. Not animal bbox center, designed foot extent or mass centroid.

view_plan.source: Exact final GLB clean-import; stable numeric cameras/light/color config and hash-bound full resolution manifest.
view_plan.greybox: Four views early; resolve corrected head silhouette, short forelimbs, long tail and complete digits before polish.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted diagnostic if a concrete unresolved issue; no default8 required for scoped model making.

scientific_limits: Living skin thickness, musculature, coloration and exact body proportions are conservative artwork, not preserved integument or specimen replica.

Brill/Carpenter corrected skull is a multi-specimen composite, not complete individual. Only Fig3.2 E/F and Fig3.3 are approved head anchors; A–D older reconstructions and Fig3.4/3.5 YPM1887 are excluded.
Gilmore1912 mounts preserve useful relative postcranial anatomy, but restored skulls, old upright/tail-dragging posture and steel supports are NOT life-anatomy evidence.
Carpenter/Wilson2008 main taxon C.aphanoecetes later separated as Uteodon: do not borrow its specific skeleton/hand. Only captions explicitly identifying C.dispar specimens are approved.
No fossil-fine diagnostic sutures or exposed tooth count demanded in living closed-mouth asset. No crest, giant thumb spike, armor or theropod claws.
Five manus digits, hindfoot three main weight-bearing digits II–IV plus small raised medial digit I; omit no digit silently. Exact phalangeal articulation is simplified, not scientific rig.

morphology.obligation: Small low elongated wedge head with gently descending snout; narrower anterior beak than rear skull, rounded compact beak not hadrosaur paddle or parrot hook. Corrected skull tapers in top view. Add restrained soft tissues; no skeletal fenestra holes in living skin. Closed mouth with no teeth exposed.
morphology.source: Brill/Carpenter PDFp3 Fig3.2 E/F and p4 Fig3.3, actual inspected pixels.

morphology.obligation: Deep herbivorous torso, compact neck, raised hips, long tapering muscular tail with smooth continuous body transition; no bead-chain tail or tail on ground.
morphology.source: Gilmore1912 plates56/59 postcrania only; body volume and modern balanced stance artist interpretation.

morphology.obligation: Two robust hindlimbs much longer than short forelimbs; thigh/calf/ankle readable, two feet planted. Forelimbs hang naturally, hands angled inward; avoid duplicated theropod arms.
morphology.source: Gilmore1912 postcranial mounts; live pose interpretive.

morphology.obligation: Each hand five short distinct digits with unequal lengths, small digitI and short lateralV; no Iguanodon-like large conical thumb spike. Each hindfoot three principal spread toes plus small elevated inner digitI. Blunt small claw tips, not huge talons.
morphology.source: Carpenter/Wilson2008 Fig23 B–E actual C.dispar manus; Gilmore1909 C.dispar hindlimb/foot description and generic pes summary.

acceptance_obligations: Four exact-finalGLB views front/side/top/perspective; numeric fixed camera/light/color template and hash-bound manifest. No full production acceptance claim.

Side: near-horizontal balanced body, small corrected head, short forelimbs, strong hindlimbs and continuous elevated tail. Top: tapered narrow beak/rear skull width, torso-tail continuity. Front: bilateral limbs, inward hands and no large thumb spike. Perspective: complete readable toes/fingers, tail clearance and cohesive volumes.
Judge against approved subfigures only; no old Theiophytalia skull or Uteodon skeleton substitutions. Specific digit ambiguity may use one targeted diagnostic rather than mandatory8views.
No foot sinking, tail-ground support, detached fingers, duplicate bead joints or strongly intersecting elbows/torso. Skin is opaque single-sided closed solids.
Two COMPLETE independent deterministic rebuilds with semantic digests; shared helpers; exactGLB/source bounds and counts; official validator separate runtime reports.
Independent reviewer must verify head evidence, digit count and morphology, not just technical pass. GPU/full-scene/profile approval remains separate.

r002 delta acceptance: exact active-scene GLB contact XY bbox centered within1e-8m; referenced indexed-expanded triangle-corner geometry exactly float32 uniform-world-translation equivalent; identical materials, source polygon topology and scene hierarchy; identity new transforms. Recomputed normal rounding and raw accessor split/index differences must be quantified, not falsely claimed identical. Old r001 independent PASS remains historical; new independent delta QA required.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.

origin_revision.scope: origin-only; no shape, pose, scale or material redesign
origin_revision.root_and_mesh_transform_policy: identity; bake one identical translation into every mesh vertex
origin_revision.algorithm: Reproduce r001; bake its existing common object Z grounding -0.0018804073333740234m into mesh vertices and set mesh transforms identity, preserving world geometry modulo float32. Measure active-scene referenced world vertices; verify minimum Z0; select |Z|<=1e-7m; compute midpoint of contact XY extrema; add identical (-centerX,-centerY,0) to every mesh vertex. Remeasure final exact GLB and disclose float32 coordinate/normal rounding.
origin_revision.transform_normalization: Bake existing common r001 Z grounding transform into vertices before origin-only XY translation; no added world-space Z displacement, modulo float32 coordinate storage.
